themeRule: Themes rotate ink, sage-wash, sage, paper over every post in (date, slot) order. A day's two posts never share a theme, and no post shares a theme with the post before it. A post with a marker in published/ keeps its theme whatever the rule says.

morning.label: 7AM
morning.note: The existing slot: owner math on weekdays, a tip or a myth on weekends. posts/index.json and published/<date>.json are unchanged, so the publisher that is live today keeps working for every rendered morning post. postHour above is the same 7 and goes away when scripts/publish.mjs reads slots.

evening.label: 6PM
evening.note: The new slot: feature, tip, feature, myth, repeating over every non-memorial day. Folders are posts/<date>-evening-<slug>/, markers published/<date>-evening.json.

rotation.weekendMorning: tip or myth: the one that day's evening is not; when the evening is a feature, the one the previous weekend morning was not
rotation.rule: A day's two posts differ in type; consecutive evenings differ in type; consecutive weekend mornings differ in type; a feature recording returns no sooner than 14 days later, with a new headline and caption. Memorial dates take no regular post in either slot and do not advance the cycle.

memorial.note: On a memorial date the 7 AM run publishes the carousel in posts/memorial/<date>/ (slide-N.jpg in order, caption.txt) once, marker published/<date>-memorial.json, and nothing else posts that day in either slot. A date with no folder posts nothing and logs a notice. The files are copies of memorial/<date>/ (never generated, never reworded).

prune.note: Media of a post whose marker is older than afterDays is removed from the Pages site (caption.txt and meta.json stay). Never a post without a marker, never posts/memorial/.

desktopCopy.note: <dir>/<date>/<date> <7AM|6PM> <type label> <slug>.mp4 and .txt, each copied once (recorded in <dir>/.copied), so a file Alex deleted never comes back. Memorial dates are never written to. render runs it at the end unless --no-desktop; DESKTOP_REELS_DIR overrides dir for tests.

captionFooter: Rhea: automated books, labor and per-store profit for multi-store owners. rheafi.com (link in bio)
captionFooterFeature: See it on sample data at demo.rheafi.com. Rhea: automated books, labor and per-store profit for multi-store owners. rheafi.com (link in bio)

captionFirstLine.note: The first line is the search sentence: what owners type (the topic in their words) and who it is for, no hashtags, under 125 characters so it shows whole before Instagram's 'more'.

hashtagRules.composition: #RunonRhea + 1 topic tag from the post type's pool + 2 audience tags from two different audience groups + 1 tag from the bookkeeping or broad group = 5
hashtagRules.rotation: No identical set of five within 14 days; consecutive posts share at most two tags; every audience group appears at least once a week; a tag not in these pools is refused (no made-up, broken, banned or vendor tags).
hashtagRules.source: Instagram, December 18, 2025: up to five hashtags in a caption for a reel or post (README: Hashtags and discovery)

hashtagPools.sizes: Not measured: no reliable public source gives current post counts, and Instagram's own search shows a count only inside the app. Check a tag's count under Search > Tags in the Instagram app before adding one; drop a tag whose page is empty or spammy.

hashtagSetRule: RETIRED on 2026-10-20 in favor of hashtagPools (the 2026-11-02 A/B review is moot: posts 1 and 2 are the only ones that went out with the old sets). Kept only until scripts/verify.mjs reads hashtagPools; builder A deletes hashtagSets and this line then.

pricing.groups: From 4 stores, a named contact and annual invoices paid by bank transfer (ACH)

pricing.rule: A post names a price only with these exact figures and words; any other dollar figure about Rhea is refused by verify.
